text:
The elements oxygen and sulfur are in the same group of the Periodic Table.
Which statement about oxygen and sulfur is not correct?
A
They are non-metals.
B
They have giant covalent structures.
C
They have six electrons in the outer electron shells of their atoms.
D
They react together to form an acidic oxide.

options.label: C
options.text: They have six electrons in the outer electron shells of their atoms.

options.label: D
options.text: They react together to form an acidic oxide.
